text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm walking down the hallway, and
Tamamo Cross
stops me as I'm about to
walk by her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. If ya happen to spot Oguri
havin' some
trouble, would ya mind
lendin' her a hand?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We're preparing for the haunted house
we talked
about before. You know, the
mummy hunt?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're the mummies, and Oguri's the
hunter. That
makes us enemies, so we
can't exactly help her
out.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If the opposin' teams get too chummy,
there's
gonna be no tension. That's why
we're taking
steps to make sure that
doesn't happen. So
thanks in advance!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I guess the elementary school
won't have a
stairwell in this spot. So, if I
want to leave the
building, then...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was practicing for the haunted
house by
imagining this is the
elementary school we're
gonna be in for
the actual event. But then I got

confused...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gruhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Inari. I'm lost... Which way's the
exit?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Whaddya askin' me for?! We're enemies, remember?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Just ask that trainer over there. You're
supposed
to be brawlin' with us
mummies.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I asked because I know I can rely on all
of you...
And by the way, three-on-one
isn't really fair.
Let's go two-on-two
instead.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Yer killin' me over here. All right,
how
'bout this? If you can beat all us
mummies right
now, we'll go two-on-two.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
In order to win, you either gotta use that
toy gun
to wipe out all us mummies, or
get all the way to
the Three Goddesses
statue safely. Whaddya
say?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...So I just have to win?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho, makin' it sound easy. Y'know I'm
just
gonna camp at the goal and ambush
ya, right?
Which means it's a race to the
Three Goddesses
statue.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And if we're racin', ya got no chance
against me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: If we're racing... I'm gonna be the winner!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oguri, that's the wrong way! It's this way!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bang! ...Gotcha. That's Creek down!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not half bad! Looks like she's
finally takin'
this seriously!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! There's nothin' like a race to
light a fire
under Oguri's butt!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Get back here!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm feelin' it! This pressure! Oguri's
gettin' closer!
But first place is—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: HAAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: MINE!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You lose, Oguri! Team Mummy for the
win! Total
victory!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It looked like you were focusin' real hard
on
Tama, so I was able to tag you on the
back too!
Faster than runnin' to the
statue, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya got beat to the statue and ya got tagged... It's a shutout, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna lose again! I'll think of a
way to
beat you guys and win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit. The hunter's supposed
to guide
the guests and help 'em out,
not us.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You did wonderfully, Oguri. Atta
girl! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eyyy, Creek! Until we're done practicin',
yer
forbidden from coddlin' anyone!
